command: set -u; echo ===LIST===; v4l2-ctl --list-devices 2>&1 || true; for d in /dev/video0 /dev/video1 /dev/video2; do echo ===DEVICE:$d===; fuser -v $d 2>&1 || true; v4l2-ctl -d $d --all 2>&1 | head -80 || true; echo ===FORMATS:$d===; v4l2-ctl -d $d --list-formats-ext 2>&1 | head -120 || true; done; echo FRED_PR133_V4L2_DEVICE_IDENTITY_READBACK_DONE
